asserts.completeness_is_the_bar: a partially applied decision is the defect at this size
asserts.size_is_a_posture: a stricter posture, not a bigger pile

name: size-enterprise
never_do: add a resource to make a scanner quiet
substitute a value for one the settled ledger already decided
quote a provider version, a retention period, a key owner or any other concrete value - those come from decisions.json and facts.json
run Terraform, OpenTofu, or any other tool
access Terraform state, cloud APIs, or cloud credentials
claim the result is compliant, verified or ready

provenance.source_reference: Written for docs/prd/tiered-component-generation.md. Shape guidance only - every concrete value is deliberately absent, because values belong to the policy baseline and the settled ledger. The connectivity-walk rules are ported from the engine's codegen-common in the iacgenius-vercel repository, which is the proven V1 prompt.

purpose: Build for a reviewer who will ask why. Every supporting control the settled decisions call for - and still never a resource added to silence a scanner.
